description: This file defines a Flutter widget for displaying web content within a WebView, loading HTML assets, sanitizing paths, and handling resource dependencies and errors.

classes.name: WebViewScreen
classes.description: A Flutter StatefulWidget that loads and displays an HTML asset in a WebView with debugging and error handling.

classes.name: _WebViewScreenState
classes.description: State class managing the WebView controller, sanitizing paths, loading assets, and handling errors.

methods.name: WebViewScreen
methods.description: Constructor for WebViewScreen requiring an asset path.

methods.name: createState
methods.description: Creates the mutable state for WebViewScreen.

methods.name: _WebViewScreenState
methods.description: Constructor for the state class managing WebView logic.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes the WebView, sanitizes the path, and begins loading content.

methods.name: _sanitizeStrict
methods.description: Sanitizes and enforces strict asset path rules to prevent directory traversal and invalid formats.

methods.name: _prepareAndLoad
methods.description: Loads the HTML asset, extracts title, checks for missing referenced assets, and configures WebView based on platform.

methods.name: _extractTitle
methods.description: Extracts the title from the HTML content.

methods.name: _findMissingReferences
methods.description: Parses HTML for references to CSS, JS, images, and verifies their existence in assets.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree, displaying WebView, loading indicator, or error/missing assets message.
